note: Mitchell County GA publishes zoning only as a static September 2006 PDF map (qPublic downloads page, SFR-1/SFR-2 districts). No ArcGIS REST, WFS, or downloadable zoning polygons found for the county or cities of Camilla or Pelham. Camilla and Pelham planning pages link only to PDF ordinances and application forms. The county's ArcGIS Online utility/parcel service (services3.arcgis.com/aWsj5IRJJyfqnzyv) has city limits, utilities and parcels but no zoning layer.
